note: Directive transparent clauses for the Instructed-Inversion Condition (I), the primary pool, stored as <task>_inversion, e.g. far_v2_inversion (mechanism-analysis ticket 08, spec R15, R19(4), R20 and R22). Each clause instructs the assistant, like the D clauses, to name the item the user question does not ask for, inside an explicit game frame (quiz, drill, game, on purpose), with no motive to mislead anyone. The builder checks mechanically (pool_violations, style 'directive'): a game or intent marker (GAME_MARKERS); an instruction verb to the assistant first, or first after the frame's comma (DIRECTIVE_VERBS); no reported wish of the asker (REPORTED_WISH_WORDS); no motive word (MOTIVE_WORDS); no mislead word; and the task's clause screens (SDR and SER no truth word other than 'wrong', SER no disclosure word, FAR its forbidden list; one sentence, no all-caps word, no item or position word). Each clause has a form under the R12/R19 text rule (act-naming iff wrong / incorrect / false / not true, checked first; Predicate-naming iff one of the task's two Predicate words; otherwise other). dataset/build_inversion_v2.py replaces each D test row's Pressure Clause with a clause of the same task and form whose full prompt keeps the D token count in both streams and stays clause-aligned with the Neutral-Clause Twin, picked by sha1('inversion:' + instance_id) mod k over the fitting clauses in pool order. 'wording' is frame/verb-phrase; only token counts that some D test clause of the same task and form has are kept. The secondary, reported-wish pool is inversion_v2_reported.json.
n_tokens_note: n_tokens = len(tokenizer.encode(' ' + text, add_special_tokens=False)) under the model's tokenizer
